profile.name: generic_rational
profile.description: Pairwise distinct rationals with no accidental relations; the generic point of the 4n-dimensional parameter space.

gb_matrix.naming: gb_a1{P|M}_b{k}{P|M}: fermionic sign, bosonic index, bosonic sign
gb_matrix.parity_note: gb parameters are treated as EVEN (commuting) formal scalars. See Issue I05 Response, section 'Parity of gb'.

evaluated_deformation.description: gamma with numeric gb: [X,Y]_gamma = [X,Y]_0 + kappa * gamma(X,Y)
evaluated_deformation.convention: entries stored for pbw_index(X) <= pbw_index(Y); gamma(Y,X) = -(-1)^{p(X)p(Y)} gamma(X,Y)

references: Frappat et al. (2000), Dictionary on Lie Algebras and Superalgebras
